authority_basis.summary: Record acyclicity of the signed occurrence-resolved four-site node Cech cone.

operations.title: The occurrence-resolved four-site node Cech cone is acyclic
operations.body: For each of 28 source terms, every vanishing denominator occurrence is retained as a simplex vertex with standard alternating signs. The augmented local simplices resolve the seven supported node classes, whose map to the rank-seven global lattice is an isomorphism. The total cone is acyclic through all degrees.

operations.title: Exact signed node-Cech cone audit across 28 terms
operations.body: The checker constructs every boundary matrix, verifies d²=0, computes exact ranks through Cech degree five, and finds zero homology for all 28 total cones.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the four-site total-energy node branch algebraically
operations.body: Entry 1181 closes the node branch. The signed occurrence-resolved Čech cone is acyclic for every one of 28 OFPT terms, including repeated labels and profiles through degree five. Combined packet: 8 A1 nodes, one total-parity relation, seven supported deck occurrences, mixed-Tate local arrangements, zero localization-cone homology. No residual marked-relative node coefficient and no new carrier. Next I am moving to the smooth quartic-double-solid marked complement and its Gysin image into the rank-20 middle system.
